author: The Q
description:
Thanks to @iGarden_Global 

I’ve been testing the iGarden Swim Jet X in real conditions, and honestly it changes how a regular pool feels. Instead of just swimming back and forth, you actually get a continuous flow you can move against, which makes the whole experience way more engaging, whether you’re training, learning, or just having fun in the water.

If you’ve been thinking about getting one, now is probably the best moment. Their Kickstarter campaign is ending on May 11, and it’s still at the lowest price with up to $1,700 off. If you order now, it should arrive right before pool season starts, which is perfect timing.

You can check it here:
https://dada.link/WLzG3o
